title: 美国13州中期选举聚焦数据中心议题
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Here's the latest Americans in 13 states facing data center questions in Tuesday's midterm elections.
segments.zh: 最新消息：13个州的美国人在周二中期选举中面临数据中心相关问题。

segments.en: Recent polling, finding that 50% of voters oppose the buildouts within three miles of their homes.
segments.zh: 近期民调发现，50%的选民反对在自家三英里范围内建设数据中心。

segments.en: Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall joins us now for more. Hey Tyler, big time for AI.
segments.zh: 彭博社的Tyler Kendall现在加入我们了解更多。嘿Tyler，AI的重要时刻。

segments.en: Yeah, big time for AI, Lisa. And at this point, really few issues in this midterm elections have bridged Americans, partisan divide quite like opposition to data centers.
segments.zh: 是的，AI的重要时刻，Lisa。目前，这次中期选举中很少有议题能像反对数据中心那样弥合美国人的党派分歧。

segments.en: And candidates across the country are grappling with what to do next as it has become a flash point in some of the most competitive races like the open US Senate seat in Texas.
segments.zh: 全国各地的候选人都在努力应对下一步该怎么做，因为这已成为一些竞争最激烈的竞选中的焦点，比如德克萨斯州开放的美国参议院席位。

segments.en: As Texas became the number one state for data center growth and constructions for passing Virginia earlier this year.
segments.zh: 今年早些时候，德克萨斯州超过弗吉尼亚州，成为数据中心增长和建设的第一大州。

segments.en: But as you heard, this is a White House that is supporting the buildout saying that it's good for competition but also good for job creation and tax revenue with the president earlier this year.
segments.zh: 但正如你听到的，这是一个支持建设的白宫，称这对竞争有利，也对创造就业和税收有利，总统今年早些时候表示。

segments.en: They're suggesting that these companies should give some financial incentives to communities to get their support.
segments.zh: 他们建议这些公司应该向社区提供一些财务激励以获得支持。

segments.en: Though we've seen that actually happen in a few localities that still say that they're going to move to block any new data center construction.
segments.zh: 尽管我们已经在少数地方看到这种情况实际发生，但这些地方仍然表示他们将阻止任何新的数据中心建设。

segments.en: Now, we have seen in the current Congress a few bills put forward a flurry of them really amid what is this heightened fervor over the issue one that would seek to impose a new excise tax on data centers another that would look to restrict their use of available business tax credits.
segments.zh: 现在，我们在当前国会看到一些法案提出，实际上是一连串的法案，正值这个问题高度狂热之际，一项寻求对数据中心征收新的消费税，另一项旨在限制其使用可用的商业税收抵免。
